limits: no movement, seed, land-purchase, or reclamation feasibility claim
absolute_action_ceiling intentionally overcredits future HIRE and potentially plantable board cells and is only an impossibility bound
current_labor_ceiling is conditional on no future HIRE credit only; it does not assume no future BUY_LAND/DIG/HARVEST
empty_owned_tiles is telemetry and is not used as a hard future impossibility cap

predecessor_bug.cause: future BUY_LAND can unlock LOCKED cells after unit phase for later same-day callbacks; DIG/HARVEST can reclaim cells
predecessor_bug.repair: cap one-sided impossibility ceilings by total observed rectangular board cells while preserving current empty-owned count as telemetry

theorem: new plants initialize consecutive_unwatered=1 and watered_today=false
EOD increments an unwatered plant and converts consecutive_unwatered>=2 to WEED
therefore a newly established crop surviving the same EOD requires at least PLANT+WATER unit actions
BUY_LAND executes in market phase and immediately unlocks the next quadrant for later callbacks, so current empty-owned cells cannot be a hard future cap
total observed board cells is a safe physical overestimate for simultaneous surviving new plants
